name: Green Fund

funder.name: Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago (Green Fund Executing Unit)

summary: National environmental grant facility of Trinidad and Tobago for registered NGOs, community-based and non-profit organisations doing reforestation, remediation, conservation and environmental education.

applicant_types.quote: Non-Governmental organizations (Registered with the Ministry or the Division with responsibility for Community Development).

geography.quote: The green fund is the national environmental fund of the republic of Trinidad and Tobago.

access.quote: It is a grant facility that is available to eligible organizations who wish to engage in environmental activities and or projects that are related to key focal areas.
